title: The Active child in the yard
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：active　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 active 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the craftsman wrote of ① an active child in the yard in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② more active than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the active ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most active child in the yard anybody in the workshop had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too active to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the active ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an active part in the work, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as active as the part in the work they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was active or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something active, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite active; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the active ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, for the whole place, she wrote of another active child in the yard in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed  more active than anybody had expected.  The most active part in the work in the whole workshop, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the active ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 活跃（前置定语 an active child in the yard：1970 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件活跃的孩子）
B. adj. 活跃／积极（比较级 more active than：文中两处，一处比院里的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 活跃／积极（最高级 the most active：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 活跃（表语 too active to do：母亲觉得它太活跃，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 积极（前置定语 an active part in the work：叔叔把整件事称作一桩积极的一份）
F. adj. 积极（同级比较 as active as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩工作中的一份相比）
G. adj. 积极（后置定语 something active：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 积极（受程度副词修饰 quite active：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an active child in the yard
the most active child in the yard anybody
an active part in the work

answers.why: active 意为“活跃”，1970 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件活跃的孩子”，此处作前置定语 an active child in the yard。
active 意为“活跃”，此处用比较级 more active than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
active 意为“活跃”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说它是工坊里最活跃的一件，故用最高级 the most active child in the yard。
active 意为“活跃”，母亲认为这件东西“太活跃了，谁也用不上”，too active to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
active 意为“积极”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩积极的一份”，此处作前置定语 an active part in the work。
active 意为“积极”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩工作中的一份一样积极”，同级比较用 as active as。
active 意为“积极”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“积极的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something active。
active 意为“积极”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当积极”，quite 修饰原级 active。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件活跃的孩子。（an active child in the yard）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更活跃。（more active than …）
母亲觉得它太活跃，谁也用不上。（too active to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩积极的一份。（an active part in the work）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩工作中的一份一样积极。（as active as …）
到了 1977 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件积极的东西。（something active）
answers: In 1970 the craftsman wrote of an active child in the yard in the ledger.
Everybody said it was more active than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too active to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an active part in the work.
He said nobody would call it as active as the part in the work they had once had.
By 1977 the ledger asked for nothing but something active.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 active 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the craftsman wrote of an active child in the yard in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most active child in the yard in the workshop, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too active to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an active part in the work, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite active, and everybody laughed.
The active ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
